name: Neptunia CSM shadows 1536x1536 (50%, experimental)
description: PS5 PPSA02721 v01.000.000 only. One verified MOVABS supplies 3072x3072 to cascaded shadow-map and shadowmap_temporary resource setup; changes both dimensions to 1536. Screen resolution and host render scale remain unchanged. Requires on-device quality and FPS validation. Turns off any separate host-side shadow downscale while enabled to avoid double scaling.
